_doc: Paid or special requirements the env-var scan cannot see (accounts, MCP logins, desktop apps). Applied by scripts/catalog_scan.py.

MaxFusion (hosted MCP: image, video, spe: MCP login: claude mcp add --transport http maxfusion https://mcp.maxfusion.ai/mcp

MegaTroll222/VOX-COLLAGE-BROLL.note: Every generation runs through a MaxFusion account; the README has a 'without MaxFusion' mode.

pyang5166/gbro-collage-broll.note: Also wants Codex image generation, which Claude Code doesn't have; use OpenAI gpt-image or Gemini instead.

Cavalry desktop app: install cavalry.studio, then run cav setup

rock3r/cav.note: Drives the Cavalry app (free tier and Pro); needs the `cav` binary in ~/.local/bin.

dillydog580/animate-roblox-characters.note: Needs Blender 4.5 + Blender MCP + Roblox rigs (all free).

zz41354899/mografy.note: Install writes a launcher into /opt/homebrew/bin and ~/.mografy and auto-updates from GitHub; graded CAUTION.
